purpose: Finish the last 10 generic open-category rows and deepen 90 highest-leverage single-blocker Career rules into source-local relation/composition subtypes without universal activation defaults.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 事业宫见煞……事业宫最不宜见陀罗……见擎羊……见火铃……
evidence_catalog.finding: The source distinguishes broad malefic-category language from named-member effects; this supports closed membership plus contextual activation rather than a universal threshold.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 天机巨门不喜火铃同度……火铃二曜，均足以增加天机之浮荡，巨门之是非。
evidence_catalog.finding: Both Fire/Bell members are explicitly sufficient in this local clause, so CA03-228 can use source-local ANY without creating a global 火铃 default.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 昌曲入事业宫，为文学、艺术……若太阳昌曲同躔……与文艺、传播、公关、演艺等有关。
evidence_catalog.finding: Two nested source statements were flattened into one AND condition; preserve them as separate branches.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 必须与魁钺同会，然后始得机会；与辅弼同会，然后始主多得助力。
evidence_catalog.finding: 魁钺 and 辅弼 are separate support channels with different effects, not one invented OR condition.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 破军不与煞忌同躔，三方亦煞轻者……化禄、化权尤佳，更见辅佐吉曜同会……
evidence_catalog.finding: `更见辅佐吉曜` inherits the immediately preceding Pojun condition; add an explicit dependency edge to CA09-846.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 破军喜见辅弼，则能减少辛劳。见魁钺不过多机会而已，见昌曲亦不能扭转劣境。
evidence_catalog.finding: Three sequential clauses have distinct outcomes; the projection must not flatten them into one group condition.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 故以得辅弼、魁钺、三台八座朝拱同会者为贵……
evidence_catalog.finding: CA08-799 and CA09-804 point to the same source sentence and same projected effect; record CA09-804 as a duplicate source-rule alias without deleting IDs in this unit.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 若无吉曜，又无煞曜（或二者均见，但力量微薄者）……有吉化吉曜……
evidence_catalog.finding: The final generic-open rows require separate absence, mixed-valence/severity, favorable-transformation/open-valence, and compound semantics; no single generic category blocker is appropriate.
